_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

customerName.description: Display value of customerId, copied from u_mes_mast_customer.name

customerScheduleName.description: Display value of customerScheduleId, copied from u_mes_plan_customerSchedule.recordNo

invoiceDate.description: Invoice date. Date field: calendar date only, stored as 00:00:00 of that day in local plant time (IST) with the +0000 suffix

asnSentAt.description: Asn sent date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

transporterName.description: Display value of transporterId, copied from u_mes_mast_transporter.name

dockLocationName.description: Display value of dockLocationId, copied from u_mes_matl_storageLocation.name

loadedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'loaded'

loadedBy.description: Display name of the user in loadedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

plannedDispatchAt.description: Planned dispatch date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

dispatchedAt.description: Date and time when the record was dispatched. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

deliveredAt.description: Date and time when the record was delivered. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

podReceivedAt.description: Pod received date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
